name: Onyx
self_text: I’m a late‑20s Spanish non‑binary who loves playing chess online. I’m looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I go at a slow pace and gear talk is my thing. I want someone to teach me post‑processing. I’m free most weeks on Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available any of Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning, otherwise it's a deal‑breaker. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a slow pace, though it's not a requirement. Nice if you are the one who teaches me post‑processing, but I won't rule you out over it.
